title: 第四章 枕上痕
slug: 穿书被杀妻证道魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你不要去，可以吗？”昏暗中一道冷峻挺拔的身影，出现在她身后的昏暗中，谢清猗转身望去，就见对方化为泡影，消失不见，她迷茫的看着幽暗处。

“如果你，定要……做此决定。”那道身影随后又在她身侧不远处出现，“那我，答应你。”

还不待她开口，那道身影彻底隐去，声音散落在空虚中。

画面一转，又变成她第一见过的那个场景，墨黑的长发与霜白袖角被风拂起，画面如同隔着水雾般看不清对方的面容，但她能感觉到对方仿佛透过她如同看进灵魂一般。

再次一觉醒来，谢清猗坐在床上眉心微蹙，和之前那个梦境说的话不一样，但怎么又梦到他了，他到底是谁？

自己为何在梦中，就会觉得心口那般酸涩，醒来后心头也依然沉甸甸的，让她无法立刻释怀。

她翻来覆去想不明白，所有人做梦都是这般吗？怎么会让人感觉如此真实，还如此难过……

为什么自从她穿来到这里后，会开始做梦，还连续梦到一个人，可不管原身还是她都不认识此人。难道，是和自己来到此地开始晕眩有关？

准备坐起身时，谢清猗发觉枕边怎么会有带着点点暗红的水痕，又想起梦中那个男人殷红的泪痕，可奇怪的是，她并不害怕这些血迹，纤细的手指轻轻触碰。

再一眨眼，只剩下水痕，刚才是她眼花了？

摇了摇头，不再去想，先梳洗打扮，一切收拾妥当，她才取下一直戴在左手无名指上的那枚紫翡戒指，置于掌心仔细端详。

此物看似是寻常饰物，却是原身自幼佩戴，从未离身之物，依照原身的记忆，她凝神探入一缕神识，果然，这正是一枚储物戒指。

神识所及，内里空间远比想象中广阔，不仅有成套的高阶阵法典籍，分门别类存放的丹药，符篆，各式光华内敛的法宝法器，甚至还有一艘仅巴掌大小，却雕刻精细的灵玉飞舟。

更令人咋舌的是灵石储备，整整一千枚灵气氤氲的极品灵石，两万枚莹润的上品灵石，四千六百枚中品灵石与两千枚下品灵石，分置在不同的玉箱之中，光华流转。

除此之外，还有数十套质地非凡，绣纹精美的上品法衣，以及任何女孩见了都会心动的胭脂水粉，珠宝首饰，琳琅满目。

“果然，哪个世界的女人都一样。”她不禁莞尔。

粗略估算了一下这修仙界的物价，才惊觉原主竟是个深藏不露的小富婆，这些资产，多半来自她父母留下的与师尊平日的赏赐。

在这修仙世界，极品灵石极为稀缺，通常只流通于顶级仙府与世家大能之间，其中蕴含的灵力纯净磅礴，远非上品灵石可比，原主竟珍藏了如此之多，平日里更是舍不得轻易动用。

“有长辈疼爱，就是好啊。”想到自己前世孤身一人，她不由得心生一丝复杂的情绪，随后又轻轻叹了口气。

毕竟，她这具身体，终究是鸠占鹊巢，不知原来世界的自己，是已成冰冷的尸体，还是由原主替代了她，在那个世界继续活下去？

思及此，一抹愧疚漫上心头，她在此界好歹有原主的师尊庇护关爱，可原主若真去了她那，全然陌生的世界，面对的便是举目无亲的孤寂，她又怎能去嫉妒原主曾经拥有的呢？

Page (1/3)

"You don't want to go, okay?" A cold and tall figure appeared in the darkness behind her. Xie Qingyi turned around and saw that the other person turned into nothing and disappeared. She looked at the darkness in confusion.

"If you are determined to...make this decision." The figure then appeared not far from her side, "Then I promise you."

Before she could speak, the figure disappeared completely, and the voice was scattered in the void.

The scene turned to the scene she had seen for the first time. Her long black hair and frosty white sleeves were blown by the wind. She could not see the other person's face clearly through the mist, but she could feel that the other person seemed to be looking into his soul through her.

When he woke up again, Xie Qingyi sat on the bed and frowned slightly. It was different from what he said in the previous dream, but why did he dream about him again? Who is he?

Why did she feel so sour in her heart when she was dreaming? When she woke up, her heart was still heavy, making her unable to let go immediately.

She turned over and over again and couldn't figure out, is this what everyone dreams about?How could it feel so real and so sad...

Why did she start to dream after she came here, and she continued to dream about a person, but neither the original person nor she knew this person.Could it be related to the fact that he started to feel dizzy when he came here?

When she was about to sit up, Xie Qingyi noticed some dark red water stains on the pillow, and then thought of the red tears of the man in her dream. But the strange thing was that she was not afraid of these blood stains and touched them lightly with her slender fingers.

In the blink of an eye, only water marks were left. Was she dazzled just now?

She shook her head and stopped thinking about it. She first washed herself and put everything in order, then she took off the purple jade ring she had been wearing on her left ring finger and placed it in her palm to look at it carefully.

This item seemed to be an ordinary accessory, but it was something that the original person had worn since she was a child and had never left her body. According to the original person's memory, she concentrated on a ray of consciousness, and sure enough, it was a storage ring.

As far as the spiritual consciousness can reach, the space inside is far wider than imagined. There are not only sets of high-level formation books, elixirs stored in different categories, talismans and seals, all kinds of brilliance and restrained magic weapons, and even a palm-sized but finely carved spiritual jade flying boat.

What is even more astonishing is the reserve of spiritual stones. A thousand top-grade spiritual stones filled with spiritual energy, 20,000 shiny high-grade spiritual stones, 4,600 medium-grade spiritual stones and 2,000 low-grade spiritual stones are placed in different jade boxes, and the brilliance circulates.

In addition, there are dozens of sets of top-quality cassocks with extraordinary texture and exquisite embroidery, as well as a dazzling array of rouge, gouache, and jewelry that will make any girl excited when she sees them.

"Sure enough, women are the same in every world." She couldn't help but smile.

After a rough estimate of the price of goods in this world of immortality, I was shocked to realize that the original owner was actually a secretly wealthy woman. Most of these assets came from the daily rewards left by her parents and her master.

In this world of cultivating immortals, top-quality spiritual stones are extremely scarce and are usually only circulated among the top immortal mansions and powerful families. The spiritual power contained in them is pure and majestic, far beyond the comparison of high-grade spiritual stones. The original owner actually collected so many of them, and is reluctant to use them easily on weekdays.

"It's good to have elders who love you." Thinking of being alone in her previous life, she couldn't help but feel a complicated emotion, and then sighed softly.

After all, her body is a dove occupying a magpie's nest after all. I wonder if she in the original world has become a cold corpse, or has the original owner replaced her and continued to live in that world?

Thinking of this, a trace of guilt filled her heart. She had the protection and care of her original owner in this world, but if the original owner really went to her, a completely unfamiliar world, and faced the loneliness of being unaccompanied, how could she be jealous of what the original owner once had?
